meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing is the final human-required handoff because the maintainer raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成版本号递增、构建校验、git 标签与发布说明生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发版都要手动改版本号、打标签、写发布说明。
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps, build checks, git tags, and changelog generation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if every release means manually editing versions, tagging, and writing release notes.

howto.what: 自动完成发布流程:判断改动属于补丁/小版本/大版本,把版本号同步到全部配置文件,执行构建、提交、打标签、推送,创建 GitHub 发行版并重新生成变更日志;npm 发布留给您手动执行。
howto.when: 当你说“升级版本号”“发个新版本”等,要求给 Claude Code 插件发布新版本时触发。

say.text: 刚修好一个 bug,把插件升一版。
say.note: Claude 按 PATCH 升级并跑完整发布流程。

say.text: 这次加了新功能,发个新版本。
say.note: 按 MINOR 升级;最后的 npm 发布交给你。

say.text: 改动会破坏旧接口,发布为 MAJOR。
say.note: 按 MAJOR 升级,走完整发布与通知流程。

howto.what_en: Automates release workflow for a Claude Code plugin: classifies PATCH/MINOR/MAJOR, bumps all version manifests, builds/syncs, commits, tags, pushes, creates GitHub release, regenerates CHANGELOG. npm publish left for the human.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to bump the plugin version or cut a new release, e.g. after a bug fix (PATCH), a new feature (MINOR), or a breaking change (MAJOR).

say_en.text: I just fixed a bug; bump a new version of the plugin.
say_en.note: Claude treats it as PATCH and runs the whole flow.

say_en.text: A new feature was added; cut a new release.
say_en.note: Runs MINOR release; npm publish is left to you.

say_en.text: This breaks old APIs—publish as a MAJOR.
say_en.note: Claude produces release notes as part of the flow.
